propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically emit confidence=0.0 because the JSON schema has no required fields on batch entries, causing the model to omit confidence values and fall below the 0.7 threshold needed for aggregate to surface findings.
Output token limit of 1024 truncates multi-candidate batches (6-candidate batches need ~1408 tokens), causing the model to abstain the entire batch when the response is truncated.
Single-candidate unit tests pass while the production batch path silently fails because canned test runners do not expose the contract and token budget defects.
The fix requires making candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain required on batch entries and scaling output budget to 256 + 192*n tokens based on batch cardinality.
A live calibration probe demonstrates near-duplicates now surface with confidence >= 0.7 after the contract and token budget fixes, with unrelated pairs correctly remaining unsurfaced.
